stops.title: The church addressed
stops.text: The capital of Macedonia, where Paul founded the church and had to leave quickly.

stops.title: Where Paul probably writes
stops.text: Paul was in Corinth for about eighteen months. Corinth isn't named in the letter; it is inferred from Acts and 1 Thessalonians.

real.label: Map of Greece, drawn from real coordinates. Numbered stops mark Thessalonica and Corinth.
